assets.title: Original Compact Two-Wheel Bench Band Saw
assets.description: Original fixed-pose compact workshop band saw with four planar feet, C-shaped rear frame, horizontal upper and lower axles, bored spoked wheels, one continuous closed toothed blade, closed wheel housings with actual band exits, correctly oriented upper and lower three-bearing guides, slotted table and insert, supported curved trunnion ears, direct rear motor, tension knob, front switch and hollow dust port. Limited teal, steel and charcoal PBR palette. All dimensions are author design values. Independent editable mesh components. No motion, cutting, anchoring, loading, manufacturability or safety certification is claimed.
